Description: OK
Resolution steps: Normal

Summary: One or more hashboards were not detected
Description: The hashboard PLUG signal was not detected
Error information: Detected power-board numbers, separated by spaces if there is more than one
Resolution steps:
1. Check the SPI ribbon connection against a working machine. Disconnect and reconnect the ribbon.
2. Replace the control board.
3. Replace the faulty hashboard (rework the puzzle board).

Description: Abnormal power-supply I2C communication
Resolution steps:
1. Replace the power supply.
2. Replace the control board.

Description: SPI communication fails on all hashboards
Resolution steps:
1. Check that the screws at both ends of the power terminals and the SPI ribbon connections are not loose.
2. Replace the power supply.
3. Replace the control board.
4. Repair the complete machine.

Description: SPI communication fails on some hashboards
Error information: Hashboard numbers with failed SPI communication, separated by spaces if there is more than one
Resolution steps:
1. Check that the screws at both ends of the power terminals and the SPI ribbon connections are not loose.
2. Replace the power supply.
3. Replace the control board.
4. Replace the faulty hashboard (rework the puzzle board).

Resolution steps:

2. Replace the power supply.
3. Replace the control board.
4. Replace the faulty hashboard (rework the puzzle board).

Resolution steps:

Resolution steps:

Summary: Abnormal hashboard communication during operation cannot recover automatically
Description: Abnormal hashboard SPI communication during operation cannot recover automatically
Resolution steps:
1. Check that the screws at both ends of the power terminals and the SPI ribbon connections are not loose.
2. Replace the faulty hashboard (rework the puzzle board).

Summary: Abnormal power-supply communication during operation cannot recover automatically
Description: Abnormal power-supply I2C communication during operation cannot recover automatically
Resolution steps:
1. Replace the power supply.
2. Replace the control board.

Summary: Connection to the mining pool is interrupted
Description: Connection to the mining pool is interrupted
Resolution steps:
If many or all miners on the same switch have this problem:
1. Check the mining-pool settings.
2. Check the network configuration, such as DHCP, DNS, and ports.
If only one or a few miners have this problem:
1. Check the mining-pool settings.
2. Check the connections to the miner network port.
3. Replace the network cable with a working mining machine. [The original wording is unclear.]
4. Replace the control board.

Summary: Damage to individual chips causes an artificially inflated hash rate
Description: Damage to individual chips causes an artificially inflated hash rate
Error information: Damaged chip number: hashboard number; separate multiple entries with spaces
Resolution steps: Send for repair.

Description: Hashboard overtemperature
Resolution steps:
1. Check whether the front and rear fans turn. If they do not, replace the fans first, then replace the control board or power supply.
2. Check that the front and rear airflow directions agree and match the other machines. If they do not, change the fan direction.
3. If the miner inlet air temperature is above 40 degrees, improve the mining-facility temperature conditions.
4. If a particular hashboard frequently overheats, replace the faulty hashboard (rework the puzzle).

Description: Cannot read the chip temperature
Resolution steps:
1. Check that the screws at both ends of the power terminals and the SPI ribbon connections are not loose.
2. Replace the power supply.
3. Replace the control board.
4. Replace the faulty hashboard (rework the puzzle board).

Summary: The control-board communication ribbon is connected incorrectly
Description: Abnormal control-board SPI ribbon connection
Resolution steps:
1. Check that the hashboard SPI ribbon connection method and sequence match other machines of the same model.
2. Replace the control board.

Description: Abnormal power supply
Resolution steps:
1. If the machine hash rate has no obvious abnormality and no board goes offline, restart.
2. Check that the screws at both ends of the power terminals and the SPI ribbon connections are not loose.
3. Replace the power supply.

Summary: Some chips do not operate correctly
Description: The number of good chips is abnormal
Resolution steps:
1. If the machine hash rate has no obvious abnormality and no board goes offline, restart.
2. Restart the miner and check whether the same error remains.
3. Replace the faulty hashboard.

Summary: Control-board type, firmware version, and chip count do not match
Description: Control-board type, firmware version, and chip count do not match
Resolution steps: After more than 10 affected units have accumulated, contact repair service.

Summary: Finally, some chips have a low hash rate.
Description: Low hash rate on the last few chip stages
Resolution steps: Send for repair.

Description: The initial aging frequency voltage is incorrect
Resolution steps: Send for repair.
